name: Tools, crafting and rules reference
blurb: What each tool does and can craft, magic item values and crafting costs, and a rules reference for coins, weapons, armour, carrying, movement, travel and scrolls.
contents: 37 tools: ability, what you can do with them (and the DC), what you can craft
Value, crafting cost and crafting time for 413 magic items
Carrying notes for 21 pieces of gear, and what spellcasting foci are for
A Rules reference with 11 tables, from the menu

rules.title: Coins & Selling
rows: 50 coins of any type weigh 1 lb.
Equipment sells for half its cost.
Trade goods and valuables (gems, art) sell for full value.

rules.title: Weapon Properties
rows: Needs ammunition to make a ranged attack; each attack uses one piece. Drawing it is part of the attack. After a fight, spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition used (round down).
Use Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls (same modifier for both).
Disadvantage on attack rolls if your Strength (melee) or Dexterity (ranged) score is below 13.

When you take the Attack action and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action with a different Light weapon; don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless it's negative.
You can fire only one piece of ammunition per action, Bonus Action or Reaction, regardless of the number of attacks you have.
Normal range / long range. Disadvantage beyond normal range; can't attack beyond long range.
Adds 5 ft to your reach when you attack with it, including Opportunity Attacks.
You can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack and draw it as part of that attack; use the same ability modifier as for a melee attack with it.
Requires two hands when you attack with it.
Can be used with one or two hands; the damage in parentheses applies when used two-handed for a melee attack.

rules.title: Weapon Mastery Properties (need a feature such as Weapon Mastery to use)
rows: Hit a creature with a melee attack: make a melee attack roll against a second creature within 5 ft of the first and within your reach (no ability modifier to damage unless negative). Once per turn.
If your attack roll misses, the target still takes damage equal to the ability modifier you used for the attack (weapon's damage type).
The extra attack from the Light property can be made as part of the Attack action instead of a Bonus Action. Once per turn.
On a hit, push a Large or smaller creature up to 10 ft straight away from you.
On a hit, the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
On a hit that deals damage, reduce the target's Speed by 10 ft until the start of your next turn (no more than 10 ft from multiple hits).
On a hit, the target makes a Con save (DC 8 + attack ability modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or has the Prone condition.
On a hit that deals damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

rules.title: Armor Rules
rows: Without training for the armor's category (Light, Medium, Heavy) you have Disadvantage on any D20 Test that involves Strength or Dexterity and can't cast spells. You gain a Shield's AC bonus only if trained with Shields.
Chain Mail needs Str 13; Splint and Plate need Str 15. If your Strength is lower, the armor reduces your Speed by 10 ft.
Padded, Scale Mail, Half Plate, Ring Mail, Chain Mail, Splint and Plate impose Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth) checks.
Light: 1 min / 1 min. Medium: 5 min / 1 min. Heavy: 10 min / 5 min. Shield: Utilize action to don or doff.
You can wear only one suit of armor and wield only one Shield at a time.
Base AC 10 + Dexterity modifier (class features such as Unarmored Defense can change this).

rules.title: Carrying Capacity (2024 Rules Glossary)
rows: Carry = Str score x multiplier. Drag/Lift/Push = Str x drag multiplier.
While dragging, lifting or pushing more than your carry limit, your Speed can be no more than 5 ft.
Example: Str 15 Medium = carry 225 lb, drag/lift/push 450 lb.

rules.title: Movement & Terrain
rows: Each foot of movement costs 1 extra foot. Not cumulative. Examples: heavy snow, ice, rubble, undergrowth, shin-to-waist-deep liquid, a slope of 20 degrees or more, a non-Tiny creature that isn't your ally.
Each foot costs 1 extra foot (2 extra in Difficult Terrain) unless you have a Climb Speed. DM may require a DC 15 Str (Athletics) check for slippery surfaces.
Each foot costs 1 extra foot (2 extra in Difficult Terrain) unless you have a Swim Speed. DM may require a DC 15 Str (Athletics) check in rough water.
You stay aloft until you land, fall or die. You fall if Incapacitated, Prone or your Fly Speed drops to 0, unless you can hover.
Switch between speeds during a move; subtract distance already moved from the new speed. Effects that change your Speed change your special speeds by the same amount.
Gain extra movement equal to your Speed for the rest of the turn.
Mounted travellers can move at twice the listed travel distance for 1 hour; the mounts then need a Short or Long Rest before doing so again.
Land vehicles use the normal travel paces. Waterborne vessels move at the vessel's speed and may travel up to 24 hours a day with enough crew.

rules.title: Travel Pace
rows: Disadvantage on Wis (Perception or Survival) and Dex (Stealth) checks.
Advantage on Wis (Perception or Survival) checks.

rules.title: Improvised Weapons & Unarmed Strikes
rows: No Proficiency Bonus to the attack; 1d4 damage of an appropriate type; thrown range 20/60. A weapon used contrary to its design (e.g. a ranged weapon in melee) counts as improvised. The DM may treat it as a similar Simple/Martial weapon.
Attack: Str mod + Proficiency Bonus; damage 1 + Str mod Bludgeoning. Or Grapple / Shove: target makes a Str or Dex save (DC 8 + Str mod + PB); must be no more than one size larger than you.

rules.title: Magic Item Rarity, Value & Crafting (DMG 2024)
rows: Value halved for consumables (potions, oils, ammunition, dusts, etc.) other than Spell Scrolls.
If the item incorporates a mundane item (e.g. +1 Plate Armor) add that item's cost to value and crafting cost.
Example: +1 Plate Armor = 4,000 + 1,500 = 5,500 GP value; crafting cost 2,000 + 1,500 = 3,500 GP.
Crafting time and cost are halved for consumables other than Spell Scrolls.
A creature can be attuned to at most three magic items at once.
Unique; can't be bought or crafted.

rules.title: Spell Scrolls (PHB 2024 scribing; DMG value = 2 x scribing cost)
rules.note: Casting from a scroll: if the spell is on your class list but higher level than you can cast, make a DC 10 + spell level Int (Arcana) check.

rules.title: OPTIONAL - 2014 Variant Encumbrance (legacy rule, not part of the 2024 rules)
rows: More than 10 x Str (up to 15 x Str)
Heavily Encumbered: Speed -20 ft and Disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls and saves that use Str, Dex or Con.
